name: decision-cabinet
description: A stateless, local MCP decision council for mapping choices, costs, disagreements, and evolving scenarios.

interface.shortDescription: Debate choices, costs, and scenarios with a four-round council.
interface.longDescription: Search the bundled knowledge base, build an offline decision map, inspect advisor lenses, and structure a four-round council debate without storing user input.
defaultPrompt: Map this decision's choices, costs, and unknowns.
Run a four-round council debate and keep the dissent visible.
Search the local knowledge base for this decision.
